  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the service of Yisrael in this world draws down Divinity from the concealed world to the revealed world, which is the purpose of creation—a dwelling for G-d in the lower realms.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And this is also what is said,</t>
    <t s="1">"Blessed is Hashem, the G-d of Yisrael, from the world and until the world,"</t>
    <t s="2">that the service of Neshama Yisrael in their descent below to engage in the fulfillment of Torah and mitzvos, which are clothed in worldly matters,</t>
    <t s="3">is</t>
    <t s="4">to draw down</t>
    <t s="5">("Blessed" from the term "drawing down")</t>
    <t s="6">Divinity</t>
    <t s="7">(Hashem)</t>
    <t s="8">from the concealed world</t>
    <t s="9">("from the world")</t>
    <t s="10">to the revealed world</t>
    <t s="11">("until the world"),</t>
    <t s="12">so that even in the revealed world there will be nullification to Divinity, in the manner and likeness of the nullification in the concealed world,</t>
    <t s="13">for this is the ultimate intention of the creation of the world,</t>
    <t s="14">that the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to have a dwelling place for Himself in the lower realms.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section questions why true contemplation of G-d's unity does not cause soul-fainting or nullification of the creatures, analogous to the sea drowning those on dry land.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>

    <t s="4">"Hear O Yisrael, Hashem is our G-d, Hashem is One,"</t>
    <t s="5">is true contemplation,</t>
    <t s="6">it should cause a matter of soul-fainting,</t>
    <t s="7">as it is said</t>
    <t s="8">regarding the sons of Aharon, when they drew near before Hashem and died,</t>
    <t s="9">for their souls expired from the greatness of the closeness, etc.</t>
    <t s="10">And similarly, regarding the drawing down from the world and until the world,</t>
    <t s="11">from the concealed world to the revealed world,</t>
    <t s="12">such a drawing down should cause the nullification of the existence of the creatures in the revealed world,</t>
    <t s="13">like the creatures on dry land who cannot enter the sea,</t>
    <t s="14">because they drown in it and are nullified from their existence.</t>

  <section v="11">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the power of G-d's Essence, which transcends both concealed and revealed worlds, enables true contemplation and drawing down without nullifying the existence of the creatures, through the concealment of gevurah.</sectionSummaryBrief>

    <t s="4">For, behold,</t>

    <t s="14">and as it is written,</t>
    <t s="15">"For with You is the source of life,"</t>
    <t s="16">meaning,</t>
    <t s="17">that the source of life of all the worlds,</t>
    <t s="18">both the revealed worlds and the concealed worlds,</t>
    <t s="19">is only "with You,"</t>
    <t s="20">which is secondary and nullified to You,</t>
    <t s="21">having no comparison at all to His Essence.</t>
    <t s="22">And since His Essence desired to have a dwelling place specifically in the lower realms,</t>
    <t s="23">specifically in this physical world,</t>
    <t s="24">specifically through the service of Bnei Yisrael as souls in bodies,</t>
    <t s="25">and "He did not create it for chaos,"</t>
    <t s="26">(but rather)</t>
    <t s="27">"He formed it to be inhabited,"</t>
    <t s="28">this causes among Bnei Yisrael that contemplation of the matter of the unity of G-d will not be in a manner of soul-fainting</t>
    <t s="29">(as with the two sons of Aharon),</t>
    <t s="30">but rather in a manner that they will remain in their existence, specifically souls in bodies,</t>
    <t s="31">specifically a physical body,</t>
    <t s="32">whose root is from the true yesh</t>
    <t s="33">which is above even the aspect of "for with You is the source of life."</t>
    <t s="34">And this is also the granting of power that the drawing down from the concealed world to the revealed world will be in a manner that the existence of the creatures on dry land will not be nullified,</t>
    <t s="35">for this matter is in the power of the Essence,</t>
    <t s="36">for which the concealed world and the revealed world,</t>

    <t s="39">and therefore it is in His power to cause that the drawing down from the concealed world into the revealed world be such that the creatures in it are like the creatures on dry land, who appear as a yesh and an independent existence,</t>
    <t s="40">and this matter is accomplished through the concealment and hiding that come from the attribute of Gevurah</t>
    <t s="41">(as above in section 3),</t>

    <t s="46">by virtue of their root in the true yesh, etc.</t>

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the service of Yisrael in this world draws down Divinity from the concealed world to the revealed world, which is the purpose of creation—a dwelling for G-d in the lower realms.

translations.translation: And this is also what is said,
"Blessed is Hashem, the G-d of Yisrael, from the world and until the world,"
that the service of Neshama Yisrael in their descent below to engage in the fulfillment of Torah and mitzvos, which are clothed in worldly matters,
is
to draw down
("Blessed" from the term "drawing down")
Divinity
(Hashem)
from the concealed world
("from the world")
to the revealed world
("until the world"),
so that even in the revealed world there will be nullification to Divinity, in the manner and likeness of the nullification in the concealed world,
for this is the ultimate intention of the creation of the world,
that the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to have a dwelling place for Himself in the lower realms.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section questions why true contemplation of G-d's unity does not cause soul-fainting or nullification of the creatures, analogous to the sea drowning those on dry land.

translations.translation: However, it still needs to be understood,
for seemingly,
when the contemplation of the matter of the unity of G-d,
"Hear O Yisrael, Hashem is our G-d, Hashem is One,"
is true contemplation,
it should cause a matter of soul-fainting,
as it is said
regarding the sons of Aharon, when they drew near before Hashem and died,
for their souls expired from the greatness of the closeness, etc.
And similarly, regarding the drawing down from the world and until the world,
from the concealed world to the revealed world,
such a drawing down should cause the nullification of the existence of the creatures in the revealed world,
like the creatures on dry land who cannot enter the sea,
because they drown in it and are nullified from their existence.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the power of G-d's Essence, which transcends both concealed and revealed worlds, enables true contemplation and drawing down without nullifying the existence of the creatures, through the concealment of gevurah.

translations.translation: But the matter is,
that there is a granting of power from a higher, more elevated place,
by virtue of which, even when one contemplates the matter of the unity of G-d with true contemplation, he will not come to soul-fainting, but rather will remain a soul in a body,
and also, when drawing down from the concealed world to the revealed world, the existence of the creatures on dry land will remain and they will not be nullified from their existence.
For, behold,
it is known
that the matter of the Holy One, blessed be He, desiring to have a dwelling place for Himself in the lower realms is in His Essence,
which is above the concealed worlds and the revealed worlds, which are sea and dry land,
above their source in the aspect of Malchus, even as it is in its ascent to the aspect of Chochmah and Binah,
which is the matter of sea
(as above in section 2),
and above both of these levels,
for even the supernal intellect, which is a "yesh" as it is the source of vitality for all the creatures below,
is only a mere illumination that is considered as nothing relative to His Essence,
and as it is written,
"For with You is the source of life,"
meaning,
that the source of life of all the worlds,
both the revealed worlds and the concealed worlds,
is only "with You,"
which is secondary and nullified to You,
having no comparison at all to His Essence.
And since His Essence desired to have a dwelling place specifically in the lower realms,
specifically in this physical world,
specifically through the service of Bnei Yisrael as souls in bodies,
and "He did not create it for chaos,"
(but rather)
"He formed it to be inhabited,"
this causes among Bnei Yisrael that contemplation of the matter of the unity of G-d will not be in a manner of soul-fainting
(as with the two sons of Aharon),
but rather in a manner that they will remain in their existence, specifically souls in bodies,
specifically a physical body,
whose root is from the true yesh
which is above even the aspect of "for with You is the source of life."
And this is also the granting of power that the drawing down from the concealed world to the revealed world will be in a manner that the existence of the creatures on dry land will not be nullified,
for this matter is in the power of the Essence,
for which the concealed world and the revealed world,
sea and dry land,
are truly equal,

and therefore it is in His power to cause that the drawing down from the concealed world into the revealed world be such that the creatures in it are like the creatures on dry land, who appear as a yesh and an independent existence,
and this matter is accomplished through the concealment and hiding that come from the attribute of Gevurah
(as above in section 3),
in which His perfection is revealed,
the perfection of all,
more than in the attribute of Gedulah,
because through it, a sense of yesh is created in the creatures,
by virtue of their root in the true yesh, etc.
